### First Horizon Bank and Greenlight Bring Family Financial Tools to Kids and Teens


October 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Bank-and-Greenlight-Bring-Family-Financial-Tools-to-Kids-and-Teens-2026.pdf)


MEMPHIS, Tenn.


, Oct. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") today announced a partnership with Greenlight Financial Technology, Inc. ("Greenlight") to give First Horizon clients and their families access to Greenlight's family financial app and safety tools. The platform combines debit cards, money management tools and financial education for kids and teens with resources that help parents and caregivers manage family finances.


Greenlight teaches kids and teens how to build healthy money habits by giving them hands-on tools to learn how to earn, save, spend and manage money. Parents and caregivers get greater visibility and control over how their children use and learn about money, and can monitor and protect senior loved ones from financial fraud


and theft


.


Eligible clients who connect a First Horizon account as their funding source can access Greenlight's Select subscription at no cost. Enhanced Greenlight plans are available at a discount for additional features and family protection.


**Greenlight Options and Key Features** **Select** ***(free)*** includes:


- Debit cards for up to five children
- 2% savings reward through Greenlight
- Automated allowance and chore management
- Quick and easy family money transfers
- Interactive financial literacy games


**Infinity Select (** ***discounted*** **)** adds:


- Investing for kids
- Family location sharing
- Driving reports
- SOS alerts
- Crash detection


**Family Shield Select (** ***discounted*** **)** adds:


- Account monitoring
- Suspicious activity alerts
- Identity protection for up to two senior family members


"Many of our clients are looking for ways to help their children build smart financial habits from an early age," said Erin Pryor, Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Marketing and Experience Officer at First Horizon Bank. "Through our partnership with Greenlight, we're excited to offer tools to help children develop healthy finance habits, while providing parents and caregivers resources to support their families and aging loved ones. Together, these solutions can help build stronger financial futures."


"We're thrilled to partner with First Horizon to bring our family finance platform to more families and make tools for financial education, money management and family safety more accessible to their clients," said Matt Wolf, Chief Commercial Officer at Greenlight. "This collaboration furthers Greenlight's commitment to helping families navigate money and life together, across all generations."


Eligible First Horizon clients can enroll by registering through[firsthorizon.com](https://www.firsthorizon.com/personal/checking-and-savings/checking/greenlight) and connecting a First Horizon account as their funding source.


**About First Horizon Corporation** First Horizon Corp. (NYSE: FHN), with $84.3 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. **About Greenlight** Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families navigate money and life together. Through its subscription plans, families get access to the Greenlight app, debit card, GPS-enabled safety devices†, and Family Hub — bringing together financial tools, scam and fraud


protection, real-time safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience for every stage of life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.


Greenlight partners with more than 200 leading banks and credit unions to bring its family finance solution to more families through the[Greenlight for Banks](https://greenlight.com/banks) and[Greenlight for Credit Unions](https://greenlight.com/credit-unions) .


The Greenlight Debit Card is issued by Community Federal Savings Bank, member FDIC, pursuant to license by Mastercard International. Greenlight Investment Advisors, LLC, an SEC Registered Investment Advisor, provides investment advisory services to its clients. Investing involves risk and may include the loss of principal. Greenlight is a financial technology company, not a bank. The Greenlight app facilitates banking services through Greenlight's bank partners. For more information, please visit:[greenlight.com](http://greenlight.com/) .


†Requires mobile data or a WiFi connection, and access to sensory and motion data from cell phone to utilize safety features including family location sharing and driving alerts and reports. Messaging and data rates and other terms may apply.
